verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a commercial POS app, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions Shopify POS source code being published or carrying an open license. POS UI extensions and the Shopify CLI are developer building blocks, not access to the product's source, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
